nodes.text: 🚇跟住農夫搭港鐵｜風生水起迎馬年 FAMA shares Lunar New Year luck to all MTR riders🐴

🎤一命二運三風水！連 @農夫FAMA都嚟咗搭港鐵行大運，仲填上新詞重新演繹風生水起，一於同大家拜個早年👲🏻👲🏻 港鐵沿綫站站都係你嘅好運路綫🛤️，聽住賀年版《風生水起》搭勻我哋嘅好運路綫，無論係去黃大仙求籤🪄、喺馬場贏開巷🐎、去車公廟轉風車，定係全家去拜年🧑‍🧑‍🧒，搭多幾轉，齊齊大吉笑唔完🧧✨ 📣年廿九至年初三（2月16至19日），大圍、尖沙咀、銅鑼灣同馬場站指定出入閘機仲有農夫嘅賀年祝福聲效🔊，過一過閘，好運UP UP！ #農夫 #風生水起 #馬年 The Year of the Horse has arrived! @FAMA takes a fortune-filled ride on the MTR and remixes their classic Lunar New Year hit to wish everyone a Happy Lunar New Year👲🏻👲🏻 🎬 Check out FAMA’s New Year song and follow their lucky journey across the MTR network! 🌟 Whether you're seeking blessings at Wong Tai Sin🪄, cheering for a win at the Racecourse🐎, visiting Che Kung Temple, or heading out for family reunions🧑‍🧑‍🧒—every MTR station is part of your good luck route🛤️. May your Year of the Horse be filled with joy, laughter, and good fortune! 🧧 📣From 16–19 February, festive New Year greetings from FAMA will be played at selected gates at Tai Wai, Tsim Sha Tsui, Causeway Bay, and Racecourse stations to share blessings on every MTR journey🔊! #LunarNewYear
MTR Chinese New Year 2014 (Year of the Horse) Campaign
